label: D1 after an a1 choice that went rare to S2, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2) and almost only in the late episode (ep_trial >= 50; rate rising toward trial 99). Within that, it fires on the D1 after the previous trial chose a1 and had a rare transition to S2 (77% of mass has prev_action a1 and every one of those is prev rare); prev_reward 0 boosts the rate but rewarded rare trials also activate. Coincides with low value (< 7.1) and a mildly positive a1-leaning policy logit; the upcoming choice is usually a1. Missed mass is mostly window-first D1 steps where the previous trial is not visible (~16%) plus a few D1s after a2 common trials (~7%). Does not fire after common a1 trials or in the first ~50 trials. Dev F1 0.60, precision 0.52, recall 0.72. Only observed variables used.
